principle_for_the_contested_cases: A single-flood notice that mentions no earlier flood is not engaged by Exclusion Code E-17, which only bites on a second or subsequent flood within N days. Citing it is noise for the adjuster; the wording that governs a single flood is Endorsement 1 (definition, sub-limit, deductible, clause 4.2 exclusions). This is a judgement call -- an adjuster might want E-17 surfaced to ask whether there was an earlier flood -- and it is the call that decides 6 of the 8 'false' labels below.
